questions.question: Which 1991 film is the only horror movie to win Best Picture?
questions.note: Oscars 1992; it also won the other four “Big Five” awards.

questions.question: Which 1994 film won Best Picture over Pulp Fiction and The Shawshank Redemption?
questions.note: Tom Hanks won Best Actor; Robert Zemeckis won Best Director.

questions.question: How many Oscars did Titanic win, tying Ben-Hur’s long-standing record?
questions.note: The Return of the King later also won 11, from 11 nominations.

questions.question: Which film won Best Picture at the 1999 Oscars, beating Saving Private Ryan?
questions.note: A famous “they robbed Spielberg” pub-quiz gripe.

questions.question: Which Lord of the Rings film was not nominated for Best Picture?
questions.note: Fellowship was nominated; Return of the King won. Two Towers still won Sound Editing and Visual Effects.

questions.question: Which 2013 film, based on Solomon Northup’s memoir, won Best Picture?
questions.note: Based on Solomon Northup’s memoir; McQueen was the first Black director to win Best Picture.

questions.question: The 2017 Best Picture mix-up happened because presenters were handed the envelope for which award?
questions.note: Emma Stone had just won Best Actress for La La Land; Moonlight was the real Picture winner.

questions.question: Which 2018 Marvel film was the first superhero movie nominated for Best Picture?
questions.note: The Dark Knight was famously snubbed for Picture; Black Panther broke through.

questions.question: Besides Best Picture, Parasite won Best Director, Best Original Screenplay, and which other Oscar?
questions.note: The first film to win both Picture and International Feature.

questions.question: Ke Huy Quan won Best Supporting Actor for which 2022 film, 38 years after The Goonies?
questions.note: He plays Waymond Wang opposite Michelle Yeoh. As a kid he was Short Round in Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom.
